name: Plesetsk LC-41/1
best_known_for: Tsiklon-3 / Kosmos-3M workhorse — 310+ launches across the Soviet/Russian era
credit: Fleet launch-site entry added during the cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). LC-41/1 was the primary Tsiklon-3 / Kosmos-3M pad and one of Plesetsk's busiest, distinct from LC-43 (Soyuz). Decommissioned after Tsiklon-3 retired.
